title: Excel for Analysis
description: Lookups, conditional aggregation, pivot tables, Power Query, and the spreadsheet habits that stop a workbook from becoming a liability.

questions.prompt: Which is an advantage of XLOOKUP over VLOOKUP?
options: It can look to the left of the lookup column and has a built-in not-found argument
It only works with numeric keys
It requires the table to be sorted ascending
questions.explanation: XLOOKUP removes VLOOKUP's left-lookup limitation and lets you specify the result when no match is found.

questions.prompt: What does $A$1 mean when a formula is copied?
options: Both the column and the row stay fixed
The column changes but the row stays fixed
The row changes but the column stays fixed
Both change relative to the new cell
questions.explanation: The dollar signs make the reference absolute, so copying the formula keeps it pointed at A1.

questions.prompt: Which tasks can a PivotTable perform? Select all that apply.
options: Group and summarise a large table
Refresh when the source data changes
questions.explanation: A PivotTable summarises, filters, and refreshes from its source. It does not clean or delete source records.

questions.prompt: You import the same CSV every week, clean it identically, and load it to a sheet. Which tool is the best fit?
options: Power Query, because the steps are recorded and repeatable
A macro that copies and pastes
questions.explanation: Power Query stores the transformation steps, so the weekly refresh repeats the same clean automatically.

questions.prompt: Which function sums values that meet two or more conditions?
questions.explanation: SUMIF handles one condition; SUMIFS handles multiple criteria across ranges.

questions.prompt: INDEX/MATCH can return a value from a column to the left of the lookup column.
questions.explanation: MATCH finds the position and INDEX retrieves from any column, so direction does not matter.
LEN counts every character including the space: D-a-t-a-space-L-a-b = 8.

questions.prompt: What does IFERROR(A1/B1, 0) return when B1 is zero?
questions.explanation: IFERROR returns its second argument when the first produces an error, so the result is 0.

questions.prompt: Which practices make an Excel table safe to analyse? Select all that apply.
options: One header row with unique column names
Structured references via an Excel Table
No merged cells inside the data range
Blank rows between each record for readability
questions.explanation: Clean headers, table objects, and no merged cells keep formulas and pivots reliable. Blank separator rows break ranges and sorting.

questions.prompt: Which dynamic array function returns rows that meet a condition?
questions.explanation: FILTER returns the matching rows and spills them into the neighbouring cells.
